name: Data Table
description: A clean, accessible data table with sortable columns, zebra striping, hover rows, a sticky header, loading skeletons, and an empty state.
usage: Import DataTable and pass typed columns + data: <DataTable columns={columns} data={rows} title="Customers" stickyHeader maxHeight="24rem" />. Sorting is uncontrolled by default; pass sort + onSortChange to control it.
